verdict.rationale: Qodo documents automatic reviews on every pull request and lets users control when reviews run (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26). It also keeps a history of findings and lets users dismiss or resolve them (qodo-docs-15, qodo-docs-3, qodo-docs-6), which only hints at state persisting across review rounds. Nothing explicitly describes incremental re-review on new commits or suppressing repeated comments. Missing for 10: explicit docs that new commits trigger an incremental re-review, tracking of which prior findings were fixed, de-duplication of old comments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
